mainImage.alt: Family of DJ protest for justice in his murder by Denver PD.
mainImage.caption: Denver District Attorney Beth McCann addresses reporters. McCann cleared three officers of criminal charges in the killing of Duane Manzanares on August 4, 2021.

body.caption: The Denver City and County Building. The Denver District Attorney's office, which cleared the officers who killed Manzanares, operates within this system that investigates itself.

body.alt: Colorado Governor Jared Polis signs the police accountability bill SB217 in 2020 with legislators and reform advocates
body.caption: Colorado Governor Jared Polis signs SB217, a landmark police accountability bill, in June 2020. Despite reforms, criminal prosecutions of police for on-duty killings remain vanishingly rare in Colorado.
